description: This file handles the deletion process of role entities within the SuiteCRM framework. It initializes a role bean, checks for the presence of a record parameter, marks the specified role as deleted, and redirects to an appropriate view after deletion.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing beans (data objects) within the framework.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the specified bean (role) as deleted in the database.
